definitions.gloss: bar hopping; pub crawl; going from bar to bar
definitions.explanation: The practice of visiting multiple bars or drinking establishments in a single night, moving from one to the next like climbing rungs of a ladder.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{梯子酒|はしござけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I ended up bar hopping last night.

examples.japanese: {新橋|しんばし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{梯子酒|はしござけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm looking forward to bar hopping in Shinbashi.

examples.japanese: {梯子酒|はしござけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{三軒|さんげん}⟦{回|まわ}ったら→回る：01150_mawaru⟧、⟦{終電|しゅうでん}→終電：05296_shuuden⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}して→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧しまった。
examples.english: After bar hopping through three places, I missed the last train.

notes:
USAGE:
{梯子酒|はしござけ} literally means "ladder drinking" — the image is of climbing from one bar to the next like rungs on a ladder. Also commonly written as はしご{酒|ざけ}. The verb form is {梯子酒|はしござけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {梯子酒|はしござけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to go bar hopping)
- {梯子酒|はしござけ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{三軒|さんげん}⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to hit three bars while bar hopping)

RELATED WORDS:
- はしご⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: casual shortened form (to hop from place to place — also used for non-drinking contexts like restaurant hopping)
- ⟦{二次会|にじかい}→二次会：08355_nijikai⟧: second party/venue (after the main gathering)
- ⟦{飲|の}み{歩|ある}く→飲み歩く：19330_nomiaruku⟧: to drink and walk around
